|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on Kessel. While your Star Destroyer here, opponent may not play interrupts from their Lost Pile. When opponent forfeits a character here, you may lose this card to retrieve X Force, where X= that character's forfeit value. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Spice Mines Of Kessel (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on Kessel. While your Star Destroyer here, opponent may not play Interrupts from their Lost Pile. If opponent just forfeited a character here, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to retrieve Force equal to that character’s forfeit. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “interrupts” → “Interrupts”; “When” → “If”; “forfeits” → “just forfeited”; removed “you”; “lose” → “place”; “card” → “Effect in Lost Pile”; “X Force, where X=” → “Force equal to”; “character's forfeit value. [Immune” → “character’s forfeit. (Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 47. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Spice Mines Of Kessel]].
* Later text: [[Spice Mines Of Kessel (V) (Virtual Set 3)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Spice Mines Of Kessel (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Spice Mines Of Kessel]].
